第10章 他怎么会录歌？！-《华娱2008：从分手快乐开始》

王小晨后悔了。

并不是后悔分手，而是后悔没有选择一个好的分手时机。

她也是现在才知道魏沐错过男主角的事情。

我真该死啊！！

他明明那么伤心，那么难过，却反过来安慰我。

而我却这样对他....

王小晨这些天想了很多，想过道歉，想过给他介绍资源以此赔罪，甚至想过再来一次，只要他能原谅自己！！

想到那些羞人的姿势，她的脸腾的一下红了，那抹嫣红迅速蔓延至耳根。

还没等她反应过来，却见魏沐一点点把扒在胳膊上的手拿开，脸上露出温暖而又疏离的笑容。

“小晨，我现在挺忙的，等忙完了再说吧。”

没一会，人离开了，留下王小晨单薄的身体，她怔怔的感受着指间快速消散的温度。

这一刻，好像两人才真的分手了。

“等一下....魏沐”

眼看着王晓晨追了出去，王传军气得牙痒痒！！

麻的，为什么啊，不都分手了，怎么还念念不忘？

他到底有什么好的？

见到晓晨离开，王传军追上去想要安慰两句，却被郑凯一把拉住。

“喂，王传军，都是一个学校的，你刚才那话什么意思？”

这小子挺装的，比他还装。

“我说你了？关你屁事？”

“看来你这是护主心切啊？”

“你特么嘴巴放干净点，听见没有。”

“我听不见。”

听到这边动静闹大，不少人纷纷把目光转移过来，其中就包含几个后世的熟脸。

李金铭，赵霁，海陆的目光中闪烁着八卦的光芒。

魏沐王晓晨可是她们班的模范情侣，在最被看好的情侣中排名第二。

没想到还是逃脱不了分手的命运。

两人分手的说法众说纷纭，虽然她们和晓晨是好朋友，但这种事情，谁都不好去问。

“呵呵.....我说错了吗？没点本事天天就知道做梦，男主角是他能当的吗？”

“你！！”

郑恺大怒，拽起王传军的衣服就要揍他。

陈贺在这个时候拦住他：“行了，先松手。大家都是同学，有什么好吵的。”

面对笑呵呵过来拉架的陈贺，王传军没有说什么：“我给你这个面子。”

他还不想得罪陈贺。

把两人拉开，陈贺继续道：“我们602都是人才，长得帅，说话还好听。尤其是魏沐，他最有才华。”

“呵呵，陈贺，我知道你跟他关系好，但也不用这样捧他吧？”

Wang Xiaochen regretted it.

It's not that I regret breaking up, but that I didn't choose a good time to break up.

Only now did she know that Wei Mu missed the leading role.

Damn me!!

He was obviously so sad and sad, but he comforted me in turn.

But I did this to him...

Wang Xiaochen has thought a lot these days, thinking about apologizing, thinking about introducing him to resources to make amends, and even thinking about doing it again, as long as he can forgive himself!!

Thinking of those embarrassing postures, her face turned red, and the blush quickly spread to her ears.

Before she could react, she saw Wei Mu taking his hand away from his arm little by little, with a warm yet distant smile on his face.

"Xiaochen, I'm very busy right now. Let's talk about it when I'm done."

After a while, the person left, leaving Wang Xiaochen's thin body behind. She felt the rapidly dissipating temperature between her fingers.

At this moment, it seemed like the two of them had really broken up.

"Wait a minute... Wei Mu"

Seeing Wang Xiaochen chase him out, Wang Chuanjun was so angry that his teeth itched!!

Damn it, why? We’ve already broken up, so why can’t we still miss you?

What's so good about him?

Seeing Xiaochen leaving, Wang Chuanjun chased after him and wanted to say a few words of comfort, but was held back by Zheng Kai.

"Hey, Wang Chuanjun, we are all from the same school. What did you mean by what you just said?"

This guy is quite pretentious, even more pretentious than him.

"I told you? It's none of your business?"

"It seems that you are eager to protect the Lord?"

"Keep your mouth clean, do you hear me?"

"I can't hear you."

Hearing the commotion here, many people turned their attention, including several familiar faces from later generations.

The eyes of Li Jinming, Zhao Ji, and Hailu sparkled with gossip.

Wei Mu and Wang Xiaochen are the model couple in their class, ranking second among the most promising couples.

Unexpectedly, I still can't escape the fate of breaking up.

There are different opinions about the breakup of the two. Although they and Xiaochen are good friends, it is not easy for anyone to ask about this kind of thing.

"Haha...did I say something wrong? He just dreams every day without any skills. Can he be the leading actor?"

"You!!"

Zheng Kai was furious and grabbed Wang Chuanjun's clothes to beat him.

Chen He stopped him at this time: "Okay, let go first. We are all classmates, there is nothing to argue about."

Facing Chen He who came over to start a fight with a smile, Wang Chuanjun said nothing: "I'll give you this face."

He didn't want to offend Chen He yet.

Pulling the two apart, Chen He continued: "We 602 are all talented, handsome and well-spoken. Especially Wei Mu, he is the most talented."

"Haha, Chen He, I know you have a good relationship with him, but you don't need to praise him like this, right?"
